messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: hosted-api (us-east-1) queue spiking. queue_depth=14,200; p95=4.6s (+160%), p99=22.1s (+250%). GPU pool=hosted-us-east-gpu util=98%. Autoscaler last attempt failed with: quota_exceeded. https://alerts.internal/ABC123

deploy-bot: autoscaler logs excerpt: "Provisioner error: quotaExceeded: project GPU quota reached". last_scale_attempt=2024-11-03T21:05:18Z

ryan_oncall: taking this. quick triage: confirmed large backlog, many requests in state=waiting >120s. any immediate fallbacks?

ana_sre: (typing) can we route non-SLA traffic to us-west or to smaller quantized variants? checking routing health.

maria_runtime: fallback policy exists but us-west capacity is limited too. quantized variants (gpt-medium-q4) have spare capacity but are lower throughput for some workloads. I can enable model-variant routing for low-priority tenants.

liz_support: impact list from error pages & alerts: ShopCart (timeouts), Searchly (p99 errors), 8 smaller tenants with increased 429/504s.

product_ops: customer-facing errors are spiking. if not mitigated within 30m escalate to exec page.

ryan_oncall: mitigation plan: 1) reroute a % of non-SLA traffic to us-west, 2) enable model-quantized fallback for best-effort tenants, 3) apply soft rate-limits for top tenants, 4) evict requests older than 180s to free workers. executing #1 now.

ryan_oncall: /run playbook route-fallback --from us-east-1 --to us-west-1 --percent 30 --filter "tenant_priority!=high"

deploy-bot: playbook started: rolling reroute -> us-west (30% of non-high tenants). progress: 1/5 shards rerouted.

ana_sre: also reducing batch_size_max on hosted-us-east-gpu to reduce head-of-line latency. command shown below:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.internal/admin/pool/hosted-us-east-gpu/config -d '{"batch_size_max":8}'
```

maria_runtime: batch_size lowered. Also enabling model-variant fallback: mapping tenants [list] -> gpt-medium-q4.

cloud-ops: pinged cloud provider for quota bump. opened request ID: CP-98765. ETA ~40m.

ryan_oncall: monitoring: queue 14,200 -> 10,200 after initial reroute. p95 -> 3.2s. p99 -> 18.0s. Good first signs but still high. Proceeding with rate-limits on top 10 tenants now.

liz_support: drafting customer note for affected tenants: "We're seeing elevated timeouts; triage in progress. We're routing traffic and applying temporary limits to restore service; ETA 30-60m." Sending to ShopCart and Searchly now.

ana_sre: evicting long-running requests older than 180s to reclaim workers:
```
POST https://api.internal/admin/requests/evict?older_than=180
```

ryan_oncall: evict command ran. reclaimed ~600 workers. queue -> 3,800. p95 2.0s. p99 7.9s.

maria_runtime: increased fallback reroute to 50% for non-SLA. p99 trending down.

deploy-bot: autoscaler logs: last_attempt=2024-11-03T21:12:10Z still returned quotaExceeded.

cloud-ops: update: provider granted temporary bump +12 GPUs, applied. provisioning can proceed.

maria_runtime: provisioning started. new GPU nodes expected ~6m. kicking off pool resize.

ana_sre: note for postmortem: autoscaler lacks early signal to prefer fallback before hitting quota. will add to actions.

ryan_oncall: new nodes joined at ~21:20Z. pool util down to 45%. queue down to ~400. p95 0.45s, p99 1.4s.

liz_support: updated customers: "Service degraded between 21:02 and 21:20. We routed traffic and scaled capacity; most requests restored. We're following up with root cause and next steps."

product_ops: severity downgraded. postmortem owner assigned to @ana_sre. If any customer exec-escalations appear, flag immediately.

ana_sre: filing postmortem and runbook updates: (1) add autoscaler preemptive routing when queue > X, (2) recommend burst quota schedule with cloud provider, (3) improve alerting for quota errors. will push draft in #postmortems.

ryan_oncall: closing incident from oncall side. thanks team. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: hosted-api/us-east-1 — total duration ~18m.
